rationale: The stock gapped up ~14% with strong relative volume but shows clear distribution in the most recent candles — a high-volume red flush from 15.70 to 15.04 followed by a weak, low-volume bounce (5842 shares) back to 15.37 — suggesting selling pressure is dominant but the bounce adds directional ambiguity. There is no identifiable news catalyst, borrow availability for shorting is unknown, and the bid-ask spread of 45.5 bps introduces meaningful slippage friction that erodes edge on a small-cap with an already volatile intraday range. Without a cleaner consolidation pattern at a defined level or a confirmed news driver, the risk/reward does not justify an entry in either direction.
